maria (docs): Heads-up — opened a PR that adds an explicit example for burst credits + clarifies how meters are reported in the pricing table. Also includes an SDK v2 header example and a note to update the dashboard link that pointed to the old panel. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
kevin (eng): thanks, linking in. quick Q: does the burst-credit example show how credits are consumed when requests exceed committed throughput? want to make sure we mirror runtime behavior.
rajiv (billing): yes please show both the meter name and a small numeric example (e.g., commit 1000u/day, burst consume 300u). otherwise customers misread. also ensure we call out which metric is billable vs. gauge.
maria (docs): good call — i'll add a table with commit/burst rows. one more ask: the dashboard link in the PR points to the old "Usage > Metering" panel — it needs to go to the new 'Billing > Tiers & Usage' panel (per product changes).
jenna (devex): FYI: SDK v1 header was `X-Redwood-Meter`, SDK v2 moved to `Redwood-Meter` (no X-). Add both snippets and a small migration note. also add the cURL example with a real token placeholder.
sam (sdk): adding the SDK v2 snippet here for copy-paste. works in both node/python flavors, simple auth header example:

```
# Node (v2 sdk)
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-2b', input: 'Summarize logs' , headers: { 'Redwood-Meter': 'tier=commit;id=team-123' } });

# Python (v2 sdk)
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
client.generate(model='redwood-2b', input='Summarize logs', headers={ 'Redwood-Meter': 'tier=commit;id=team-123' })
```

sam (sdk): feel free to reword but this is the exact header shape we expect.
deploy-bot: docs-site build succeeded for PR 482 — preview available at https://deploy.previews.redwood.dev/482 :white_check_mark:
maria (docs): perfect — i'll update the PR with the numeric example and swap the dashboard link. tagging @kevin for the runtime correctness note and @rajiv to verify the numeric billing example before merge. can we aim to merge by EOD tomorrow?
kevin (eng): i'll validate the burst semantics vs runtime today and post a 1-line confirm. if mismatch i'll add an inline callout about approximate behavior vs billing.
rajiv (billing): i'll review the numbers and confirm tomorrow morning. if all good, approve.
maria (docs): thanks all — once approved i'll backport a short migration snippet to the v1->v2 migration guide and add a redirect for the dashboard link. :pray:
